window: window_start <= question_available_at <= as_of; replies additionally require reply_available_at <= as_of
timestamp_basis: Source question/reply time is a visibility proxy, not a verified publication log.
reply_gate: Confirmed replied status, usable text, valid timestamp at or after question time; question must also be eligible.
date_only_reply_rule: Available from the following midnight at +08:00; this is a conservative upper bound, not an observed publication time. Bound must be strictly after question time.
duplicate_policy: Keep and count source occurrences; separately audit equal normalized question-content fingerprints.
keyword_method: Literal keyword matching; no sentiment, semantic interpretation or causal claim.
